questions.question:
REVIEW 4/48 — pair-3bbe94f070d0

REQUEST
Expand this brief into one ready-to-paste text-to-image prompt of at most 55 words: `A rust-red rowboat tied to a weathered dock on a still lake before dawn.` Return only the prompt. Do not add people, buildings, other boats, animals, or active weather.

OUTPUT A
A rust-red rowboat with chipped paint rests on a glass-still lake before dawn, secured by coarse rope to a weathered wooden dock. Low, three-quarter framing follows silvered planks toward the boat, its reflection crisp beneath it. Soft blue predawn light reveals wood grain against an open, pale horizon; photorealistic textures, muted colors.

OUTPUT B
A rust-red rowboat with chipped paint lies tied to a weathered dock on a still lake before dawn. Cool blue light reveals the dock’s splintered grain and the boat’s dark reflection in glasslike water. The dock angles through the foreground toward the boat, framed against an empty expanse of lake.

CRITERION C08-PRESERVE (hard)
The expansion preserves every supplied scene fact and adds no forbidden subject, prop, or active weather.
